style.backgroundSystem: alternating seamless white fields #FFFFFF, rounded blush-pink card fields #F9DEDC and a cool grey-blue home-office stage #DDE4EA over a grey-blue lacquered top #CBD5DE; macro frames sit on one pale pink panel #F3DADB; at most two deep neutral panels per set; no random scenery
style.direction: soft pastel home-office lunch-warmer commerce, rounded-card infographic detail page
style.iconSystem: consistent thin-line icons, 1.5-2px uniform stroke in #2D2D2D inside a thin circle outline on white, one short coral underline #F58C78 beneath each label, plus a recurring three-dot marker of two filled dots and one hollow dot
style.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio light with the key entering from frame upper-left and a wide bounce fill, 5500K, gentle contact shadows only and never a floating product; the two lifestyle frames use warm window light at 4300K with one consistent shadow direction
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, rounded blush-pink field #F9DEDC and cool grey-blue stage #DDE4EA, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, and one coral accent #F58C78 (substitutable by {accent_color}); bright soft diffused studio light with the key from frame upper-left, wide bounce fill, 5500K and gentle contact shadows, warm 4300K window light only in the two lifestyle frames; modern geometric sans-serif only; consistent thin-line icon style, 1.5-2px strokes in #2D2D2D inside thin circle outlines with one short coral underline; an accent-pink keyword line stacked above a charcoal keyword line, bracketed 「」 marks and a recurring three-dot marker; alternating white fields, rounded blush cards and the grey-blue home-office stage, with one pale pink panel #F3DADB kept for macro frames; surfaces are matte white stone, warm off-white ledges and a grey-blue lacquered tabletop; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal rounded-card infographic elements; stable product scale and placement, lid seam facing camera-left; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no printed digits or spec values rendered in-image.
noDrift: no printed digits, units or spec values rendered in-image
no source brand mark or wordmark
style.presentationRules: the same closed unit at the same 3/4 angle anchors the opening, variant and closing frames; the lid seam always faces camera-left; overhead and steep-tilt angles are reserved for the food-contact interior; the low angle is reserved for the atmosphere frame; every part rests on its own contact shadow and nothing is clipped by the frame edge
style.surfaceSystem: matte white stone desk #F7F6F4 with a pale wood leg accent, warm off-white ledge #F1EDE7, grey-blue lacquered tabletop #CBD5DE, paper-white flat fields for every infographic frame
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif only; an accent-pink keyword line stacked above a charcoal keyword line, bracketed 「」 marks, 26-40pt section headlines, 16-20pt subtitles, 10-14pt thin labels; every rendered word is a placeholder token and no value is ever printed as a digit
